audit_items.proof_trace: The withdrawal function does not accept a separate Obligation object parameter; it uses obligation_owner_cap.id() (returning the immutably-set obligation_id) as the key to look up the obligation via market.handle_withdraw → obligations.borrow_mut(obligation_id). Because the ObjectTable was populated with obligations.add(object::id(&obligation), obligation), the retrieved object's ID is by definition equal to the cap's obligation_id, satisfying cap.obligation_id == obligation.id at all times. The cap's obligation_id field has no public setter and ObligationOwnerCap.new() is package-private, preventing forgery.
